courses.title: Yoga Nidra With Sufi Poets
courses.description: Two downloadable Yoga Nidra tracks, about 39 minutes in all, that bring the poetry of Rumi and Hafiz into a guided rest between waking and sleep. Gentle binaural tones run underneath; Rachel Boucher offers them for unwinding and inner stillness.

courses.title: Seasonal Yoga Nidra
courses.description: Four guided Yoga Nidra recordings, one for each season, each between 26 and 36 minutes and built around that season's imagery. They are meant for deep rest, easing tension and keeping in step with the year's rhythms.
